qr-code-generator.formula: A QR code is a grid of dark and light squares called modules. The error-correction level decides how much of the grid can be damaged or covered and still scan: L recovers about 7%, M about 15%, Q about 25% and H about 30%. Higher correction stores more backup data, so the grid gets denser for the same text.
